data.name: Ajeeb
data.gender_notes: Ajeeb is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ajaba' which means to amaze, surprise, or astonish. Ajeeb is a name that signifies the wonder and enchantment of the unknown. The name Ajeeb carries the meaning “Strange, unusual, marvelous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ajeeb usually hope their child will grow to embody strange, unusual, marvelous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ajeeb is a name that represents the mystery and magic of the universe. It is a reminder of the wonders of creation and the hidden secrets of the universe. It is a name that inspires us to explore the unknown and to seek out the mysteries of life.
data.etymology: Ajeeb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strange, unusual, marvelous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ajeeb total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
